install: Copy *.tmTheme to $(bat --config-dir)/themes/ and run bat cache --build
installSteps: Copy `Cyclorama Dawn.tmTheme`, `Cyclorama Steel.tmTheme`, and `Cyclorama Day.tmTheme` into `"$(bat --config-dir)/themes/"`.
Rebuild bat's syntax theme cache with `bat cache --build`.
Select your variant with `bat --theme="Cyclorama Dawn"` (or add `--theme="Cyclorama Dawn"` to `$(bat --config-file)`).
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: TextMate .tmTheme dark syntax palette on #050507 with Beacon Orange functions, Steel keywords, and Signal numbers.
themes.copyLabel: Copy Cyclorama Dawn bat install command
themes.copySnippet:
mkdir -p "$(bat --config-dir)/themes"
cp "apps/bat/Cyclorama Dawn.tmTheme" "$(bat --config-dir)/themes/"
bat cache --build
bat --theme="Cyclorama Dawn" README.md
